title: MachineRegistry: 1,016 machines - data completeness

actual_count.notes: Registry designed for 824 machines per header, but no extracted data files present

discrepancy.description: Milestone states 1,016 machines, registry header says 824 machines, actual loaded count depends on extracted data files
discrepancy.explanation: MachineRegistry loads from data/extracted/machines/ directory which is not populated. Inline defaults exist for 23 machine types and JM Die has 21 specific machines in ShopConfigurationEngine.

jm_die_machines.data_quality: HIGH - complete shop-specific specs from JM Die

findings.finding: MachineRegistry designed for external data import that hasn't been populated
findings.impact: LOW - Inline defaults and JM Die configuration provide sufficient coverage for calculations
findings.action: Populate data/extracted/machines/ or adjust milestone expectations

recommendations: MachineSpindleDefaults provides reasonable fallbacks for unknown machines
JM Die shop configuration is fully specified - serves as reference implementation
